lines.text: Many learners say: I read twenty book last year.
Better: I read twenty books last year.

data.wrong: I read twenty book last year.
data.right: I read twenty books last year.

native.tip: في العربية «عشرون كتابًا» بالمفرد، أما هنا فنضيف s بعد العدد: “I read twenty books last year.” وليس “I read twenty book last year.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I read twenty book last year.” 😅 في العربية «عشرون كتابًا» بالمفرد، أما هنا فنضيف s بعد العدد، فالجملة الصحيحة “I read twenty books last year.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.tip: In Arabic «عشرون كتابًا» is singular, but here we add s after the number: “I read twenty books last year.” not “I read twenty book last year.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I read twenty book last year.” 😅 In Arabic «عشرون كتابًا» is singular, but here we add s after the number, so the right sentence is “I read twenty books last year.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
